verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean states the same pair, written in a different but routinely equivalent form. (i) First component: Lean uses r·∂_r(u_θ^{(0)}/r) (`shearVector`'s `q.1 * slowR F q` with F = leadingFrequency = u_θ^{(0)}/r), which equals ∂_r u_θ^{(0)} - u_θ^{(0)}/r by the product rule u_θ = r·(u_θ/r); the paper writes the difference directly. (ii) Second component is ∂_r u_z^{(0)} in both. (iii) The scalar prefactor in Lean is `leadingFrequency = q^{-A-1/2} F` and the bracket is (-angularShear, -signedAxialShear) = -𝔰, so the right-hand sides agree. (iv) The Lean carries hypotheses the paper's display does not: 0 < h, h < 1/2, C ≠ 0, SmoothCoefficients d, 0 < r, 0 < τ, the point in D.carrier, P.f ≠ 0, and germ agreements d.phi 0 =ᶠ C • P.f, d.axial 0 =ᶠ P.U identifying the chart jets with the profile.
